title: EIA canonical error envelope
description: Canonical error body for every EIA API, modelled on RFC 9457 application/problem+json (SPEC 6.11 and 12.2). Unknown members must be ignored by consumers. The canonical code scheme is EIA-<VERT|-PLT|-TX>-<NNNN> (SPEC 6.11); a service that still emits a legacy code such as NOT_FOUND is tracked in MISMATCHES.md. correlationId, transactionId, and meta are part of the canonical envelope but are not emitted by every service yet.

type.description: Problem type URI that identifies the error class. Services derive it from the stable error code.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

status.description: HTTP status code generated for this occurrence.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation for this occurrence. Never contains PHI, SQL, stack traces, tokens, or table names.

instance.description: Request path that produced the problem, for example /api/v1/policies/0192f3a4-2b7e-7d1f-a9c4-3e8b5f0c9d21.

code.description: Stable error code in the SPEC 6.11 scheme, for example EIA-PAY-5101. Never reused for a different meaning.

category.description: Failure category from SPEC 6.11. Consumers may branch on it; it is more stable than the HTTP status.

retryable.description: True only when the identical request may be retried without a business change.

correlationId.description: Correlation identity of the request chain (SPEC 12.6). Not emitted by every service yet.

transactionId.description: Business transaction identity when the failure happened inside a transaction submission.

errors.description: Field-level problems. Empty when the failure is not attributable to a specific field.

meta.description: Additional machine-readable context for the failure, for example the caller's authority limit. Never contains PHI.

field.description: JSON field or request parameter name.

code.description: Stable machine-readable field error code, for example INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION.

examples.title: Invalid status transition
examples.detail: Assumed claim status cannot move from OPEN to PAID.
